interaction_target: a stranger who has a real public address, signal, offer, place, or question
borrowed: nothing. It is the estate's own paper identity — the ink, the lime, DM Sans and Instrument Serif the compiled pages already use — at editorial scale rather than in cards.
shape: one live aperture with four territory characters — an immediate evidence-route form, three existing-owner doors, and one public weather-carrier read
refusal_states: refused (401/403) — named in the gate, with the authority the pattern declared and the code it answered
empty (200, no records) — an empty projection
failed (other) — nothing rendered rather than stale or invented
actions: GET /_surface/intake with one public URL only. The form prepares a reviewed route; it does not fetch, retain, publish, settle, or grant authority. The other links enter existing Discover, Market, Studio, and account owners.
forbidden_inference: a public URL entered into intake -> evidence, a ForeignTwin, canonical truth, or authority over the foreign system
a public weather-carrier count -> weather truth, retained source body, or a claim about an unavailable carrier
a door into Discover, Market, Studio, or account -> permission or a completed effect
a landing page -> a product; all effects remain with the owner reached through its door
requires_authority: none for the bounded intake preparation and public carrier count. Account state is fetched from the native session owner; Discover, Market, and Studio decide their own authority at the later owner boundary.

lineage.note: replaces the dashboard/catalogue root with a bounded immediate operation. The host chooses a distinct territory character in the browser; machine requests still receive the native discovery descriptor.
